title: Stir-Fried Nostalgic Mac and Cheese
description: A comforting twist on a classic mac and cheese, incorporating nostalgic flavors and gooey textures. This dish combines the comfort of childhood with the savory umami of stir-fried ingredients.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk to create a roux. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in milk, whisking continuously. Bring to a simmer.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and mozzarella cheese until melted.
Stir in tomato sauce and cooked macaroni.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish and top with additional cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and gooey.
